# datagecko_runner_hook (Resource)

The hook a runner is rung at, on one ingest key. One key, one hook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datagecko_ingest_key" "runner" {
  name = "runner"
}

resource "datagecko_runner_hook" "runner" {
  key_prefix = datagecko_ingest_key.runner.id
  url        = "https://runner.example.com/datagecko/ring" # https only; never put a secret in it, it is logged
}

# datagecko_runner_hook.runner.secret signs every ring; changing url issues a new one.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_prefix` (String) The ingest key the runner holds.
- `url` (String) https on port 443, at most 500 characters. It is logged: never put a secret in it. A change issues a new secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key prefix: the import identifier.
- `last_ring_at` (String) RFC 3339, or empty if never rung.
- `last_ring_status` (String)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signs every ring. Shown once, on create and on every url change; never read back, so an imported hook has none until its url changes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the ingest key's prefix. The secret cannot be recovered: it stays null
# until the url changes, which issues a new one.
terraform import datagecko_runner_hook.runner dg_ab12cd34
```
